title: Clean Windows delivery matrix evidence
description: Candidate-bound evidence for the two clean Windows environments. This schema records execution; it does not turn an unexecuted fixture into a passing release verdict. A release may only claim the clean-install delivery contract when every required (environment, command) row is present, bound to the exact candidate version, executed with exit code 0, and backed by a regular non-empty artifact file inside artifactRoot. The enforcing predicate is scripts/verify-delivery-matrix.cjs. Electron's official platform support for the pinned version is 'Windows (Windows 10 and up)' (electron/electron README at tag v44.4.5, https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/v44.4.5/README.md), which is why the windows-10-1809-x64 fixture floor is build 17763 (Windows 10 version 1809).

candidateVersion.description: The exact candidate version every row must also carry. A row bound to a different version is stale evidence and fails verification.

synthetic.description: Required. True only for test controls: a synthetic index is never machine evidence, and the verifier's pass record and PASS line echo this value. Omitting it would let a pass record read as real evidence nobody produced, so a missing or non-boolean value is rejected.

artifactRoot.description: Directory all row artifact paths resolve against, given relative to this index file. It must exist and be a directory; every referenced path must stay inside it.

rows.description: The verifier additionally requires the exact environments x commands cross-product (see scripts/verify-delivery-matrix.cjs).

build.description: The Windows build actually observed on the clean machine. Permitted ranges are applied per environment id by the allOf clauses on each row.

rowId.description: Must be exactly '<environment.id>:<command>'. A required row that is absent, duplicated, or renamed fails verification by row id.

command.description: For the ten automated rows this is the exact npm script invocation. The four clean-environment rows are named observation scenarios instead of shell commands: 'machine-wide install with-uac-elevation', 'start-menu shortcut launch', 'uninstaller profile deletion', 'artifact completeness'.

toolVersions.description: No value may be a placeholder (empty, TBD, todo, n/a, none, unknown, unexecuted, or <angle-bracketed>).

execution.description: Only 'executed' can pass. 'unexecuted' is the honest value for a row no VM has run, and it fails verification.

artifactPath.description: Path relative to artifactRoot. It must exist, be a regular file, and be non-empty; an absolute path, a traversing path, a directory, or an empty file fails by row id.

installerPath.description: Required on the 'artifact completeness' row. Relative to artifactRoot; must be an existing non-empty regular file.

applicationExecutablePath.description: Required on the 'artifact completeness' row. Relative to artifactRoot; must be an existing non-empty regular file whose PE header reads Machine 0x8664 (AMD64) and OptionalHeader.Magic 0x20b (PE32+).

shortcutPath.description: Required on the 'start-menu shortcut launch' row. Relative to artifactRoot; must be an existing non-empty regular file: the Start-menu shortcut the per-machine install created, which is the machine-wide shortcut any account on the machine can launch rather than one bound to the account that ran the installer. It is copied back into the evidence tree because the verifier cannot reach the live Start menu on an arbitrary machine.

profilePath.description: Required on the 'uninstaller profile deletion' row. Must name the machine-wide data tree root the uninstaller removes, %PROGRAMDATA%\youtubetv-for-windows, mirrored relative to artifactRoot as 'ProgramData/youtubetv-for-windows' (an absolute machine path is refused like any other absolute path, because the verifier has to resolve the path itself to prove it is gone). A per-user %LOCALAPPDATA% / %APPDATA% path, or a leaf inside the machine tree, names a path the uninstaller never deletes in that shape and is rejected; the named path must NOT exist at capture time. A missing or placeholder value fails: a bare boolean is not evidence of deletion.

profileAbsentAfterUninstall.description: Required on the 'uninstaller profile deletion' row. Must be exactly true, and it is only meaningful alongside a concrete profilePath that names the machine data root and that the verifier confirms is absent.

adminElevationRequired.description: Required on the 'machine-wide install with-uac-elevation' row. Must be exactly true; a missing value fails, and so does false, because the machine-wide install must have shown a UAC prompt and an install that needed no elevation is not the claimed delivery.
